paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Kohen: [Demai, chapter 2, end of halakhah 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Demai.2.1.21). He had a brother named Magbila, as in [Berakhot, chapter 3, halakhah 1, folio 21a](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.3.1.19).
Rabbi Bun bar Kohen: [Maaser Sheni, chapter 4, halakhah 6](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Maaser_Sheni.4.6.5).

notes.text: The linked Demai has Rabbi Abba bar Kohen asking Rabbi Yose. The linked Berakhot gives [Gedilah] as Abba’s brother. Hyman and [Heilprin’s Abba entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=9&lang=en) give Magbila.

The linked Maaser Sheni names Rabbi Bun bar Kohen. Ketubot has Rav Dimi report a homily by Rav Nachman bar Kohen, also cited by [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2681&lang=en). These three patronymics leave open whether the fathers were the same person.
